identity.patternName: Strategic Product Direction Versus Delivery Reality

sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: PO System: Leading Product Ecosystems; Shaping Product Strategy. PO Value: Optimising the Value Chain; Optimising Product Portfolio Value. Squad System: Working Within Team Boundaries; Developing Shared Standards. Squad Value: Delivering Output; Measuring Delivery Performance.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: PO behaviours may indicate strategic product or ecosystem direction, while Squad behaviours may indicate a more bounded or output-oriented delivery focus. This may suggest that strategic direction is not yet translating into the Squad's day-to-day delivery context.

sourceEvaluation.notes: Candidate evidence is not yet an executable trigger. Confirm required, alternative, supporting, and contradictory behaviour combinations before defining conditions.
